At the bottom of the figure is written "organic trash", and there are many arrows connecting from insects, small animals, birds, etc. at the bottom and middle-lower part to animals at higher levels. An owl is drawn in the upper left, located at a relatively high position in the consumer area, and there are arrows pointing to it from lower-level animals; the figure does not show predators higher than the owl. Reasoning: The question asks what is at the highest point of the food chain, that is, the top consumer in the figure. Based on the arrow relationships and position, the owl is in the position of the highest predator, so the answer is owl.
